body.statement: Theorem 4. For every budget sequence with \(s_J/J\to\rho\in[0,1]\), \[\lim_{J\to\infty}J R^*(J,s_J)=\min\{\rho,1/2\}.\] If \(0\le\rho<1/2\), then every sequence \(q_J\in\mathcal Q^*(J,s_J)\) satisfies \(\mu_{q_J}\Rightarrow\delta_{(0,0,1)}\), equivalently convergence holds in \(W_1\) on \(\Delta_2\).
body.justification: The formula quantifies the exact robustness value of pairing and identifies the phase boundary where first-order risk stops selecting the design.
body.gap: SudijonoDobribanTchetgen2026 and Hull2026BoundedOutcomes give the unrestricted endpoint constant, while Bai2022MatchedPairs gives a paired prescription under another criterion; no source derives this interpolation or concentration theorem.
body.consumer: The curve maps an analyst-selected discordance fraction to the sharp first-order sample-size cost and identifies when the minimax design must concentrate asymptotically on mixed pairs.
